title: Orsen and the Kitchen
author: Ansel Vane
blurb: Astrid Hartwell, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
